plugin.note: Desert Lizards have no elemental weakness and only Defence level 20, so any melee weapon works. The key mechanic is the ice cooler: each lizard must be finished with an ice cooler once it drops below 5 Hitpoints. Bring waterskins for the Desert Heat.

requirements: 22 Slayer is required to kill Desert Lizards (no combat requirement).
Ice coolers are mandatory to finish each lizard below 5 Hitpoints; Ancient ice spells do not substitute.
Waterskins (or desert-resistant gear) are needed for the Kharidian Desert heat.
mechanics: A Desert Lizard must be finished with an ice cooler when it has fewer than 5 Hitpoints; used at 5+ HP the cooler is wasted.
The Reptile freezer perk (10 Slayer points) auto-ices a lizard below 5 HP if an ice cooler is carried.
Desert Lizards have no elemental weakness and Defence level 20, so weapon choice is unimportant.
Ancient Magicks ice spells do NOT count as the ice-cooler final blow.

methods.label: Melee with ice coolers
methods.summary: Chip each lizard below 5 Hitpoints with any melee weapon, then finish it with an ice cooler.
steps: Fill up on waterskins and ice coolers and travel into the Kharidian Desert.
Attack a Desert Lizard with any melee weapon until it drops below 5 Hitpoints.
Use an ice cooler on the weakened lizard to finish it.
notes: Buy the Reptile freezer perk (10 points) to auto-ice lizards below 5 HP.

methods.label: Reptile freezer perk
methods.summary: With the Reptile freezer perk unlocked, simply carry ice coolers and kill normally.
recommendedFor: players who own the Reptile freezer unlock
steps: Unlock Reptile freezer from a Slayer Master for 10 points.
Keep ice coolers in the inventory and attack Desert Lizards normally.
The perk automatically ices each lizard when it falls below 5 Hitpoints.
notes: A Magic or Ranged approach also brings lizards into ice-cooler range, but melee is simplest.
